tools.name: Actelo
tools.positioning: Financing software for French IOBSP credit brokers, covering the calculation, document and invoicing side of a mortgage file.
tools.description: Actelo is a French SaaS platform for IOBSP credit brokers. It covers the financing side of a mortgage file end to end: eligibility and amortisation calculations, borrower insurance quoting, generation of the regulatory financing documents, a document management space, a borrower portal, invoicing of the parties involved and activity statistics. It is sold per user with a published monthly price and no commitment.
tools.real_estate_use: A mortgage broker takes in a buyer whose offer has just been accepted and has to turn a project into a bankable file within days. Actelo runs the calculation side: it works out which loan structures the project is eligible for, prices the borrower insurance, lists the supporting documents to collect, and produces the financing proposal and the regulatory paperwork. The borrower drops the documents in their own space instead of emailing them, and the broker follows the file stage by stage until the invoicing of the commission. Independent brokers and franchise networks use it as their whole back office rather than as an add-on to a CRM.
features: Automated financing calculations and loan structuring
Borrower insurance pricing and one-click quote
Configurable financing documents and electronic signature
Document management and borrower self-service portal
Stage-by-stage file tracking
Invoicing of brokers, mandataires and partners, with activity statistics

use_cases.job: Produce a financing proposal and its supporting file for a buyer whose offer has been accepted
Run a network of mandataires on one workspace with per-user billing and shared reporting

tools.name: Blend
tools.positioning: The borrower-facing front end a bank puts in front of its origination system.
tools.description: Blend provides digital application experiences for mortgage, home equity and consumer lending: guided borrower application, automated asset, income and employment verification, document collection, status tracking and loan officer tooling, integrated into the lender's origination system.
tools.real_estate_use: The failure point in mortgage is the borrower experience: a form that asks for two years of bank statements as PDFs loses applicants to a competitor. Blend replaces that with direct connections to payroll and bank data, so verification happens in the application instead of three weeks later, and the loan officer sees a complete file sooner.
features: Guided digital mortgage and home equity applications
Automated asset, income and employment verification
Document collection with borrower status tracking
Loan officer workspace and pipeline visibility
Integration with origination systems and pricing engines
Configurable workflows per lender product

use_cases.job: Reduce application abandonment with verified data instead of document uploads
Give borrowers a live status view instead of a phone call for every update

tools.name: Créditéo
tools.positioning: Web applications for French IOBSP credit brokers: prospect files, financing simulation and shared access for bankers and introducers.
tools.description: Créditéo is a French publisher of web applications for IOBSP credit brokers. The product is organised in modules: prospects and clients, a financing simulator with amortisation tables, a participants module to share a file with introducers, borrowers and bankers, a statistics workspace and a configuration workspace. It is browser-based with no installation, and exposes an API to create a prospect file from the broker's own website.
tools.real_estate_use: A brokerage that generates leads through its own website wires the form to the Créditéo API so an enquiry lands as a file rather than as an email. From there the broker builds the financing simulation, including the loan smoothing cases that make a multi-loan plan hard to compute by hand, and shares the file with the introducer who brought the client and with the bank contact. The borrower gets an account showing which documents are still missing and where the file stands. The vendor states it equips both national networks of several hundred mandataires and small independent firms.
features: Prospect and client file management
Financing simulator with amortisation tables and loan smoothing, including insurance on outstanding capital
Shared file access for introducers, colleagues, borrowers and bankers
Borrower account for document upload and file tracking
Activity statistics workspace
API to create a prospect file from the broker's website

use_cases.job: Turn a website enquiry into a financing file and produce the loan simulation with the client
Give a network of mandataires a shared file workspace with per-firm configuration

tools.name: Eloa
tools.positioning: SaaS platform for French credit intermediaries, whose eCredits module runs a mortgage file against the broker's own bank agreements.
tools.description: Eloa publishes a family of SaaS products for French credit intermediaries. Its real estate module, eCredits, handles a mortgage file from simulation to funding: pre-qualification simulators covering amortising, in fine, relay, staged and PTZ loans, bank convention and rate-schedule configuration, document collection, commission and invoicing rules, and activity ratios. A separate eImmo line covers rental, renovation and condominium financing. The company also sells unrelated modules for used-vehicle dealers.
tools.real_estate_use: A credit broker configures Eloa with the bank agreements they actually hold: rate schedules, required documents, commission terms, branch coverage. From there a borrower profile produces personalised simulations against those specific banks rather than against generic rates, which is the comparison work that is the broker's job. Rights management and document completeness rules are set per firm, so a national network of mandataires and a one-person brokerage can run on the same product with different process rules. The vendor also markets a condominium loan module used by syndics financing building works.
features: Loan simulators covering amortising, in fine, relay, staged and PTZ structures
Configuration of bank conventions, rate schedules and required documents
Automatic file creation from the simulation, avoiding double entry
Configurable invoicing and commission rules
Rights management and per-firm process configuration
Condominium works loan module

use_cases.job: Compare personalised loan plans against the broker's own bank agreements instead of published market rates
Arrange a collective loan to finance works voted by a condominium

capabilities: assisted preparation and processing of loan files

tools.name: Encompass
tools.positioning: The loan origination system a large share of US mortgages are actually manufactured in.
tools.description: Encompass is a loan origination system covering the mortgage lifecycle: application intake, processing, underwriting, closing document generation, compliance testing and delivery to investors, with a configuration and partner ecosystem around it.
tools.real_estate_use: A residential mortgage is a regulated manufacturing process — disclosure timing, fee tolerance, appraisal ordering, TRID compliance — where a missed deadline is a legal defect, not an inconvenience. Encompass encodes those rules in the workflow, which is why it sits at the centre of most lender operations and why the whole vendor ecosystem integrates with it.
features: End-to-end loan origination workflow from application to funding
Automated compliance testing including TRID and disclosure timing
Closing document generation and e-signature
Product and pricing engine integration
Investor delivery and secondary market handoff
Extensive partner integration marketplace

use_cases.job: Manufacture a compliant residential loan file from application to funding
Deliver closed loans to investors without re-keying the file

tools.name: Floify
tools.positioning: Document collection and borrower communication for the individual loan originator, not the enterprise.
tools.description: Floify is a mortgage point-of-sale and document portal: borrower application intake, secure document collection with automated chasing, milestone notifications to all parties, and loan officer pipeline tools, sold at a price an individual originator can carry.
tools.real_estate_use: Most of a loan officer's day is chasing paperwork and telling agents where the file stands. Floify automates both — it requests missing documents until they arrive, and notifies the borrower and both agents at each milestone. For a small brokerage or an independent originator it replaces the enterprise point-of-sale they cannot buy.
features: Borrower document portal with automated follow-up requests
Loan application intake and 1003 form handling
Milestone notifications to borrower, agents and partners
Loan officer pipeline and task management
E-signature and secure document storage
Integration with origination systems and credit providers

use_cases.job: Stop chasing borrower documents manually on every file
See loan milestone status without calling the loan officer
